description: Answers: Which public companies disclosed a cybersecurity incident voluntarily, without declaring it material? The reply opens with a one-line answer and its date. Cyber Disclosures. SEC 8-K Items 8.01 and 7.01 · cybersecurity incidents disclosed voluntarily · the filer’s own sentence. Sourced from SEC EDGAR; every row links to its filing. Free, CC BY 4.0.

limit.description: max rows, default 50, ceiling 200 — the reply carries total/returned/truncated, and `more` links the full board

name: get_cyber_disclosures
